description: This file defines the RefreshTokenEntity class, which implements the RefreshTokenEntityInterface for handling OAuth2 refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM system. It manages properties such as identifier, expiry time, and associated access token, including methods to get and set these attributes.

classes.name: RefreshTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 refresh token entity with properties and methods to handle token identification, expiration, and linked access token.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the refresh token.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the refresh token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTimeImmutable object for the refresh token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date-time for the refresh token, overriding it to the current UTC time plus the server's refresh token TTL.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Associates an access token entity with this refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the associated access token entity.
